description: Aggregate-state exciton coupling, J/H aggregation, excimer/exciplex formation, or aggregate electronic states explain emission enhancement, shift, or quenching.
positive_evidence: crystal packing with pi contacts linked to exciton coupling
insufficient_evidence: only red shift without aggregate-state assignment

triage_policy.high: Primary paper with molecule-level aggregate exciton/excimer evidence and controls.
triage_policy.medium: Likely aggregate-state photophysics paper with incomplete snippet evidence.
triage_policy.reject: Review or no aggregate electronic-state evidence.
